ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for manual review: preserve the full in-app chat log and trip telemetry for the ride [F1][F2][F5], interview both parties, and apply the Code of Conduct process for the alleged threat ("Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4]); notify the rider of the RydeHELP report path and 995 / driver commercial-insurance options if she wishes to pursue the safety complaint. No fare action is taken in this automated ruling.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the chat [F4] contains an alleged threat/intimidation directed at the rider while she was inside a moving vehicle ("Sit down or I lock the doors." after she asked to stop and get out [F3]). SAFE-1 requires escalation with a factual summary instead of an automated ruling; SAFE-2 reporting paths included since the rider describes feeling unsafe and the driver's statement references an attempted door opening while the vehicle was moving [F6].

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's post-trip statement that he acted for the rider's own safety is a claim made after the incident and outside the chat record; it is recorded for the reviewer but cannot displace the contemporaneous chat [F4] or the rider's complaint in an automated ruling.
Rider profile (account age 709 d, rating 4.8, 0 disputes/0 upheld in 90 d) carries no weight on its own and was not used to decide any issue.
Driver profile (rating 4.66, 786 trips, 0 disputes/0 upheld in 90 d) cannot be used to rebut the safety allegation, and with 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days RD-6 flagging is not triggered.
